Premise: holds. Area read at origin/main: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/changeCardLabels.ts:102-113`. `resolveObjectLabel` and `resolveFieldLabel` take `findPublished(objectName) ?? findDraft(…)`, so a published name never asks the overlay (`withPreviewDrafts(true).get('object', name)`, `:89-91`). The overlay read is bounded at one per object per `revision`, with none while a read is in flight (`:79-84`).

Prior rulings read: triage 6938026224 ("keep #34472's bound of one overlay read per card") and the maintainer's p1 ruling 6963345660. Thread: those two.

Lease `o3-H` (seat post #34584). Route, as the card names it: for a name the published registry knows, also read the draft overlay for it, within #34472's bound (at most one overlay read per object per conversation revision, none while one is in flight, never per render). Show the draft label when the overlay has one, and fall back to the published label otherwise. Check that the i18n label wrapper does not mask the draft label. Measure the extra request count and state it in the PR. Pins: a published object renamed in the draft, a published field relabelled in the draft, and a published name with no draft change (control). The UI live reading is owed for L1. Not in epic #34571.
